Basement apartments are at high risk of flooding
items.body: If you live in a basement apartment, be prepared to move to a higher floor or evacuate during periods of heavy rain

items.label: Reduce water overflow
items.body: Do not use showers, sinks, or any object, machine, or device connected to the building's plumbing system

items.label: Report damage to 311 immediately
items.body: Be particularly vigilant about downed wires
